content: परिवर्तिन् {%a.%} .²1 Moving or turning round, revolving. .²2 Ever-recurring, coming round again and again; परिवर्तिनि संसारे मृतः को वा न जायते <ls>Pt. 1. 27</ls>. .²3 Changing. .²4 Being or remaining near, moving round about. .²5 Retreating, flying. .²6 Exchanging. .²7 Recompensing, requiting.
